text: L'Auxiliaire is a mutual insurance company for building and public-works professionals ('mutuelle d'assurance des professionnels du bâtiment et des travaux publics'), with its head office in Lyon. It describes itself as a mutualist firm governed by a board made up only of heads of building and public-works companies, with 15,000 member-clients ('clients-sociétaires').
short: L'Auxiliaire is a mutual insurer for building-trade professionals, governed by a board of its members' company heads.

source.name: L'Auxiliaire: L'Auxiliaire renforce son engagement aux côtés de LDLC ASVEL et affirme son identité lyonnaise (communiqué de presse)
source.quote: Acteur mutualiste gouverné par un Conseil d'Administration composé exclusivement de chefs d'entreprises du BTP
